entries.title: the one i waited for.
entries.body:
i don't know how to explain it.

but there's something about arlan that makes my days feel better. the way he talks, the way he makes me smile without even trying, and how somehow, he finds his way into my thoughts even when i'm doing something else.

sometimes, i catch myself smiling at the smallest things just because they remind me of him. it's funny.. how one person can make an ordinary day feel special.

i don't need everything to be perfect. i just want the little moments, the random conversations, the silly jokes, the late-night talks, and the feeling of having someone i genuinely want to tell everything to.

and if there's one thing i wish arlan knew, it's that he means more to me than i always know how to say. 

so, dear diary, if one day i ever forget how to put my feelings into words, let this page remind me of one simple thing; it was arlan, and it was always the little things about him that made me smile.

entries.title: oh, how’s your day?
entries.body:
i wonder how his day went today. 

did he laugh a lot? was he tired? did something make him happy? sometimes, i wish i could see the lil’ moments of his day that he doesn't usually tell anyone about :3

one of the nicest things about knowing someone is.. slowly learning the little things abt them. their habits, the things they like, what makes them laugh, and the random stories they tell without realizing i'll probably remember them later.

anyway, enough rambling for tonight yaa hihi. i hope he had a VERY good day, and i hope tomorrow treats him even better.

until my next little entry, bailee.

entries.title: learning (&.) losing
entries.body:
one of the hardest things about losing someone is realizing that the world doesn't stop because yours feels different. 

days keep passing, people keep laughing, and life continues as if nothing has changed. 

meanwhile, i’m trying to understand how something that once felt so familiar can suddenly become a memory.

i never really understood how strange it feels to miss someone who used to be a part of your everyday life. not always about crying, wishing things could go back to the way they were. sometimes, it's just seeing something that reminds you of them and having to sit with the feeling for a moment before moving on.

maybe, losing someone doesn't always mean they disappear completely. sometimes, they stay in the songs you can't listen to the same way anymore, the places that hold memories, or habits you picked up when they were around.

and the hardest part is learning to live with the absence of someone who once occupied so much space in your life.

if i ever read this again someday, i hope i'll be kinder to the version of me who wrote it. i hope i'll understand that losing someone doesn't mean i wasn't enough, and not every goodbye is something i could have prevented.

for now, i'll let myself miss what i miss. i'll let myself feel what i feel. i don't have to be okay tonight just because another day has passed.

maybe tomorrow will hurt a little less.
and maybe one day, it won't hurt, at all.

posts.text: the only exception on life. my reason to stay. my reason to live. my reason to continue everything. my bailee.
i'll choose you, every time. every lifetime.
